instruction:
MISSION: ROADMAP_NEXT

OBJECTIVE:
Execute the next mission defined in the approved roadmap.

INSTRUCTIONS:
- Read and follow the roadmap exactly.
- Complete only the next pending mission.
- Respect all mission dependencies.
- Produce a Patch Plan before implementation.
- Reuse existing public APIs and components whenever possible.
- Preserve backward compatibility.
- Run the complete validation suite.
- Fix any regression before completion.
- Produce the final report.
- Commit and push when the mission is fully validated.
